wiki_article: **The Analog Advance: Operations Paper — Taking the Handwritten Niche** is a methodological specification by Lee Sharks under the Rex Fraction heteronym, deposited 9 August 2026 as the third document of the analog trilogy: EA-SPXI-ANALOG-01 (#1409) specifies how, the field survey (#1443) establishes why, and this paper orders when, where, and in what sequence. Its opening doctrine — a niche is taken by enrolled objects, not by arguments — governs ten sections: an incumbency map placing ARK, DOI/IGSN, Trismegistos, C2PA, and accession practice around an unserved segment defined as the living author whose composition layer makes origination deniable; a one-sentence positioning claim (AXN is the identifier for the hand that must prove itself to machines); the thirty-minute enrollment path; four schema deltas scoped as Addendum A to the standing specification; a ten-item reference corpus in which each enrollment demonstrates one capability, including the registry's first rumored-object record; a four-page product-surface wing for axnidentifiers.org with browser-side verification; two near-term empirical batteries — recapture stability, and glyph transmission survival, whose datum zero is the survey's own PDF build; a five-rung adoption ladder with institutions deliberately last; a gated ninety-day order whose final gate is the first enrolled hand belonging to neither founding depositor; and a risk register answered from standing archive doctrine.
